column1: # Seasoning: salt, pepper, dried spices, spice blends, dried herbs.
# Columns, tab-separated: id, labelRu, labelEn, parentId, divisible, factors, removed, synonymsRu, synonymsEn, nutrition, nutritionSource (dictionary/README.md).
# Salt (7000-7099). Level measures: fine salt tsp 7 g, coarse and flaky salts lighter.
# Pepper and chili (7100-7199). Peppercorns and allspice berries are counted (pc) and never halved.
# смесь перцев → fdc:170931 black pepper: a peppercorn mix is mostly black and white pepper
# хлопья чили → fdc:170932 ground red (cayenne) pepper: the flakes are the same dried red chili, crushed
# чипотле молотый → fdc:168570 sun-dried hot chile: chipotle is a dried (smoked) hot chile
# гочугару → fdc:170932 ground red pepper: Korean ground dried red chili
# перец алеппо → fdc:170932 ground red pepper: ground dried red chili
# перец эспелет → fdc:170932 ground red pepper: ground dried red chili
# перец гуахильо сушёный → fdc:168570 sun-dried hot chile: guajillo is a dried hot chile
# перец кашмирский → fdc:170932 ground red pepper: ground dried red chili
# Spices, ground and whole (7200-7399).
# семена горчицы → fdc:170929 ground mustard seed: the same seed, whole
# горчица сухая → Skurikhin «Порошок горчичный»: the Russian powder is milled from defatted seed, unlike the US ground seed (Skurikhin 12.2.16, p. 192-193)
# чеснок сушёный → fdc:171325 garlic powder: the same dehydrated garlic
# имбирь сушёный ломтиками → fdc:170926 ground ginger: the same dried ginger
# Spice blends and seasonings (7400-7499).
# Dried herbs (7500-7599). The fresh herbs are produce («укроп свежий»…); here only what is sold dry.
# мята сушёная → fdc:172239 dried spearmint
